title: Commit and Trust God
truth: God loves us and wants us to trust Him with everything, knowing He will always help us.
points: Give your plans and worries to God.
Believe God will keep His promises.
God will work things out for your good.
apply: Today, tell God about something you are worried about or a dream you have, and ask Him to help.
prayer: God, thank You for loving me and promising to help me when I trust in You with all my heart.
